kernel.frame.description: Synchronize presentation and cap foreground frames at your monitor's refresh rate. Native menu and idle limits still apply. Shows paced FPS and an estimated uncapped rate; moves into F3 when debug is open.
kernel.frame.managed: Frame Sync manages the live cap and VSync. Turn it off to use these saved native settings.
kernel.option.block_face.description: Reuse block face visibility results in a bounded cache for each render worker.
kernel.option.block_model.description: Reduce temporary model-selection objects, random sources and quad lighting arrays where supported.
kernel.option.chunk_queue.description: Index pending section tasks by position and remove cancelled tasks promptly. Keep the game's original priority rules.
kernel.option.chunk_uniforms.description: Share unchanged camera matrices within each chunk drawing batch. Keep previous snapshots intact for the graphics uploader.
kernel.option.chunk_upload.description: Spread chunk uploads across render passes. Adapt the 0.25–2 ms budget to recent frame work, with at most 32 tasks per pass.
kernel.option.fluid.description: Calculate fluid corner heights without allocating a temporary accumulator.
kernel.option.frustum.description: Reduce the work needed to check whether a bounding box is visible to the camera. Visibility decisions stay unchanged.
kernel.option.model.description: Reduce temporary allocations when rendering model parts and cubes.
kernel.option.pose.description: Reuse temporary matrices in rendering. Older versions also reuse pose entries.
kernel.option.quad_sorting.description: Use stable radix sorting for large translucent meshes while preserving the game's distance order.
kernel.option.section_buffers.descriptio: Create GPU objects for a chunk layer when it is first used. Empty layers avoid unnecessary allocation. Available on 1.21.4; newer versions already allocate layers on upload.
kernel.option.vertex.description: Reduce temporary allocations when transforming and uploading vertices.
kernel.option.visibility.description: Use a scanline search to calculate which section faces are connected through empty space.
kernel.resource.readers.description: Use smaller text buffers while loading resources at startup and during reloads. Large files remain supported. Requires a restart.
kernel.settings.current_launch: These settings match the current launch
kernel.settings.restart: Restart Minecraft to apply these settings
kernel.settings.save_failed: Could not save. Check the game log and retry.
kernel.settings.subtitle: Choose which optimizations run at launch
kernel.settings.title: Kernel renderer
kernel.shaders.backend: Shader packs are written for OpenGL. This game is running on %s, so there is nothing Kernel could load here.
kernel.shaders.backend_status: Shaders are unavailable on this graphics backend
kernel.shaders.empty: Drop a shader ZIP to install it
kernel.shaders.no_options: This pack does not declare any options.
kernel.shaders.options_hint: Options come from the pack itself. Changing one recompiles it immediately.
kernel.shaders.ready: Installed · click Enable to check compatibility
kernel.shaders.scope: Deferred, composite and final passes. Packs that draw world geometry are not supported yet.
kernel.shaders.title: Shaders
kernel.video.brightness.description: Lighten the darkest parts of the world. This does not change the light level of blocks.
kernel.video.clouds.description: Whether clouds are drawn, and whether they are flat or three dimensional.
kernel.video.detail.hint: Point at a setting to read what it changes. Cancel discards everything since the last Apply.
kernel.video.distance.description: How far, in chunks, the world is drawn. This is normally the strongest single influence on frame rate.
kernel.video.entity_distance.description: How far entities are drawn, as a share of the render distance.
kernel.video.exclusive.description: Let the game take exclusive control of the display in fullscreen. This can lower latency and makes switching windows slower.
kernel.video.fov.description: How wide a view the camera covers, in degrees.
kernel.video.fps.description: The highest number of frames drawn each second. Unlimited draws as fast as the machine allows and raises power use and heat.
kernel.video.fullscreen.description: Draw the game over the whole screen instead of in a window.
kernel.video.gui_scale.description: How large the interface is drawn. Auto picks the largest scale that fits the window.
kernel.video.leaves.description: Draw leaves with see-through gaps instead of as solid blocks.
kernel.video.lighting.description: Smooth the lighting across block faces. Turning this off costs some quality and saves chunk build time.
kernel.video.mipmaps.description: How many smaller copies of each texture are used at a distance. Higher values look calmer while moving and use more memory.
kernel.video.particles.description: How many particle effects are drawn.
kernel.video.quality.description: The overall graphics preset used for transparency, clouds and leaves.
kernel.video.recommendation_description: Conservative starting point for %s logical CPUs and %s MiB of JVM heap. Recommends %s render chunks, %s simulation chunks, clouds and particles based on GPU class. This is a heuristic, not a measured optimum. Apply to save; your other settings stay as selected.
kernel.video.resolution.description: The resolution and refresh rate used for fullscreen. Desktop keeps your current display mode.
kernel.video.screen_effects.description: How strongly nausea and the Nether portal distort the screen.
kernel.video.shadows.description: Draw the simple shadow underneath entities.
kernel.video.simulation.description: How far, in chunks, the world keeps ticking. Entities and blocks beyond this distance stop updating.
kernel.video.vsync.description: Match presentation to the display refresh rate. This removes tearing and usually adds a frame of latency.
kernel.world.biome_offsets.description: Reuse seed-dependent biome offsets for nearby blocks without caching biome or chunk state. Applies to the client and integrated server after restarting Minecraft.
kernel.world.end_island_heights.descript: Reuse identical native End island heights across repeated terrain samples. Bounded per-thread storage preserves exact terrain values. Requires a restart.
kernel.world.lithium: Kernel leaves these world internals to Lithium while it is installed.
kernel.world.noise_slices.description: Avoid allocating noise interpolation rows twice during world generation. Values, random streams and generation order are unchanged. Requires a restart.
kernel.world.packed_storage.description: Decode common packed block arrays with fewer variable shifts. Storage formats and palette values stay unchanged. Requires a restart.
kernel.world.shape_construction.descript: Reduce temporary memory use when building block shapes during startup and world updates. Requires a restart.
kernel.world.shape_coordinates.descripti: Share immutable coordinate lists for common cube grids during shape queries and construction. Requires a restart.
kernel.world.shape_traversal.description: Accelerate native voxel overlap tests with bitsets and bounded coordinate mappings. Custom shape and operation behavior stays in control. Requires a restart.
